displayPattern: Display on a GE dishwasher with electronic controls: PF (not all codes are found on all models)
meaning: Power failure: GE says PF indicates that there has been a power failure to the dishwasher. It is a notice, not a part failure.
causes: Power to the dishwasher was interrupted, for example an outage or a tripped breaker
diySteps: Select the cycle and options you want
Press the Start pad. GE says the dishwasher will then function normally
GE notes that not every code is on every model. If your GE dishwasher has no display, PF will not appear
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: GE's only step for PF is to select the cycle and options and press Start. If the dishwasher will not run after that, GE's same page says that disconnecting power for a minute or two can clear a code, and that service may be needed if that simple reset does not clear it. PF is not C4, which is a machine that filled twice after a power failure, and it is not 999.
sourceTitle: Dishwasher – Error, Fault or Function Codes (GE Appliances)
